# Dev Creation

> Artisanal Luxury Handcrafted Soy Wax Sachets, Wax Melts, & Botanical Fragrances. Handcrafted in India.

Dev Creation creates masterfully poured 100% pure botanical soy wax sachets, delicate scented melts, and gypsum/ceramic aroma stones. Infused with IFRA-certified fine perfume oils to gently scent wardrobes, closets, drawers, bedrooms, cars, and personal sanctuaries for 4–6 weeks.

## Collections & Products
- [All Products](https://devcreation24.in/products/): Complete handcrafted collection of luxury wax sachets, wax melts, and aroma stones.
- [Wax Sachets](https://devcreation24.in/categories/wax-sachets/): Long-lasting botanical wardrobe, closet, and drawer fresheners with satin hanging ribbons.
- [Wax Melts](https://devcreation24.in/categories/wax-melts/): Pure botanical soy wax melts for ceramic diffusers and burners.
- [Aroma Stones](https://devcreation24.in/categories/aroma-stones/): Flameless decorative ceramic and gypsum diffuser stones.
- [Luxury Gift Sets](https://devcreation24.in/categories/gift-sets/): Curated gift boxes with signature gold wax seal packaging for weddings, festivals, and corporate celebrations.
